title: Green Alien Emerging
description: A green alien with a large head, big black eyes with red slits, and blue lips has red liquid dripping from its mouth. Its pink tentacle-like arms with claws are touching a broken rocky ledge, set against a cracked white background with dark smoke and a black void behind it.
prompt: A green alien creature with a large smooth head, huge black eyes with red markings, and blue lips is shown from the shoulders up, red liquid dripping from its open mouth. It has a long neck with ridges and pink tentacle arms with claws resting on and touching a broken rocky green ledge. The background is a cracked white surface with black and grey smoke and a dark void behind the creature.
